subject.title: fix(channels): centralize access gates and media fallback

question: Should `resolveInboundSupplementalSenderAllowed` and `sendPayloadTextChunkSequence` become permanent public Plugin SDK contracts in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is additive and internally useful, but shipping the exports commits OpenClaw to supporting their generic semantics for external plugins; that API-boundary choice requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Accept the shared SDK contracts
options.body: Approve both additive exports as the canonical plugin-facing primitives and retain the cross-channel regression coverage.

options.title: Keep them internal for now
options.body: Use the helpers for bundled channels without exporting them until an external plugin use case and stable contract are documented.

options.title: Split the API decision
options.body: Land the channel bug fixes separately and review the public Plugin SDK additions in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared SDK contracts
recommendation.body: Approve both additive exports as the canonical plugin-facing primitives and retain the cross-channel regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most directly to the shared Plugin SDK reply surface, channel-policy centralization, and API-budget update.
